claim: As of February 2025, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google held a combined 84 GW of tracked large-scale clean-energy contracts and accounted for 98.7% of the non-utility U.S. corporate PPA market in that dataset.
comparisonContext: This shows that the same firms driving data-centre growth are also dominating corporate clean-energy procurement.
scopeNote: Tracked large-scale corporate PPA market figure, not a claim that all data-centre load is already matched hour-by-hour.
sourceTitle: Meta, Amazon, Google, and Microsoft Dominate Clean Energy Deals
